name: Words in parentheses
about: Words in (parentheses) anywhere go to the slide notes; a translation and a reference in parentheses stay on the slide.

runs.text: Grace is a gift, not a wage (hold up the envelope here).
For by grace you have been saved through faith (Ephesians 2:8).
Romans 5:8 (NIV) – But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
